notes.title: Afallon Demo Update
notes.content: [p]The latest demo build for [i]Afallon[/i] is here, and it comes with some exciting new features, visual upgrades, and performance improvements![/p][p][b] New Features[/b][/p][p][b]Early Character Customisation[/b]  You can now pick from a small selection of beards and hairstyles to give your hero a bit more personality.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/715f61e1f3f414a6cf8d1b42a5546e42e135325d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Playable Dwarves[/b]  Short, sturdy, and ready for adventure. The Dwarves have officially joined the fray![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/ea455ce2f3d23f9c47df025d15edac8162a83210.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Fishing[/b]  Cast your lure, add some bait, and reel in fish! This is the first step toward a larger fishing system that will be expanded in future updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/f5e849621c012fb37d6248f9e68e26b97386cc65.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Buff & Debuff UI[/b]  Active buffs and debuffs are now displayed on-screen. Hover over them to see detailed tooltips explaining which stats they affect.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/193ca58530a90cddad3f4de3395cca5cca3c6f0e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Visual & Performance Improvements[/b][/p][p][b]Lighting Overhaul[/b]  Improved real-time shadows for a more immersive and dynamic world.[/p][p][b]Sharper Image Quality[/b]  Swapped out TAA for FXAA, resulting in a much clearer picture.[/p][p][b]Performance Boost[/b]  Overall performance has been improved by around [b]30%[/b] compared to the last demo build.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/fac79c01662ba270f53508ce94121cebe47f70a4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]Fixed numerous bugs affecting pets and companions, improving their behaviour and reliability.[/p][p]This update brings [i]Afallon[/i] one step closer to the full experience while making the world look and run better than ever.[/p]

notes.title: Afallon Development Update
notes.content: [p][b]Afallon Development Update – Dynamic Lighting, Smarter NPCs & A Living World[/b][/p][p]Over the past few months, major improvements have been made to [i]Afallon[/i], both under the hood and in how the world feels to play in. Here's what i've been working on:[/p][h3][b]Reworked Lighting System[/b][/h3][p]The entire lighting system has been overhauled. All light sources in the game now cast dynamic shadows, creating a much more atmospheric world, especially during night and interior exploration. The best part? This comes with [b]zero increase in performance cost[/b]. Thanks to significant optimizations, performance has actually improved across the board.[/p][p]In benchmarks at [i]Aradia's Camp[/i] in [i]Coalway Swamp[/i] during rain, framerate on the dev machine used to average around [b]89 FPS[/b]. After the optimizations, it now sits around [b]112 FPS[/b], representing a [b]20–30% performance increase[/b] depending on the area.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/d4e3adbde29128e4ff2474c2d2ad7e07da7465dc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/dce63252c0db53f78cd31cd50416c10e97c3e4b0.png"][/img][/p][h3]Time of Day Matters[/h3][p]Time of day now has real impact on gameplay:[/p][list][*][p][b]NPCs now respond to the time of day.[/b] Human merchants, for example, close their shops and head to bed at night—no more midnight shopping sprees.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New nighttime spawns[/b] include shady black market merchants with rare or questionable goods.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Certain haunted areas[/b] become active only at night, with ghosts and restless spirits appearing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Roads grow more dangerous after dark[/b], as bandits, vampires, and other threats roam more freely at night.[/p][/*][/list][p]This adds a deeper layer of strategy to travel and exploration, you may want to think twice before venturing out after dusk.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/486cf0ce6d14a04d1c88ed1e082f2fc33c236fc7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/8212b1056d60723b832db2a80f19a5001a9e3631.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/29e3b70f8894777dd2b20915e8f30cf17e7585a2.png"][/img][/p][h3]Property Ownership & Passive Income[/h3][p]A new [b]property and business ownership system[/b] is currently in development and already making good progress. Players will be able to purchase:[/p][list][*][p][b]Taverns[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sawmills[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon shops[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]And more…[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]These can be [b]upgraded[/b] to provide [b]higher passive income[/b], as well as unlock [b]unique quests, rare crafting materials, and special recipes[/b]. Managing your assets will become an important part of your character’s growth in the world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/3c70030c1c9d41ed86ac1d3fd47e8141d0744520.png"][/img][/p][h3]A World That Changes With You[/h3][p]To make Afallon feel more alive and less static, i am introducing more [b]dynamic, randomized world events[/b], such as:[/p][list][*][p][b]Meteor strikes[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bandit ambushes on caravans and travelers[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hostile attacks on villages and settlements[/b] triggered by nearby enemy camps[/p][/*][*][p][b]Local populations reacting to these threats[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]These events help ensure that no two playthroughs feel the same and that the world evolves as you interact with it.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/73954cedfe551d784fcb407ab4ddf0cdc5315e28.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/c97cabb6016c9f0c4232a78dd8037d0b34b5db24.png"][/img]More Coming Later This Summer[/h3][p]More information will be revealed later this summer through [b]in-depth videos[/b] showcasing and explaining the new systems, world mechanics, and design philosophy behind [i]Afallon[/i]. You’ll get a closer look at features like the [b]Fishing system[/b], as well as the newly added [b]Drunk effects[/b], where drinking alcohol gives temporary buffs or debuffs, depending on how far you push it. As your "drunk stacks" increase, your screen becomes blurrier. Drink too much, and you’ll [b]black out and wake up in a random part of the world[/b], potentially far from where you started.[/p][p]I will also be showcasing [b]new immersive visual details[/b], such as contextual drinking animations where your character visibly drinks the actual item selected, whether it’s a potion, a mug of ale, or a bottle of wine.[/p][p]Stay tuned, this is only the beginning.[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.8.3 character controller rework
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I've been working hard on improving Afallon, and I’m excited to share this update with you. It includes a big rework of the character controller, some new features, and a number of important bug fixes based on your feedback.
[b]
Major Changes[/b]
Complete Character Controller Rework
One of the most requested changes has been improving the way the character controls. I’ve taken that feedback seriously and reworked the system from the ground up to feel more like traditional MMO 

[b]controls:[/b]
Hold right mouse button to rotate your character.
Hold left mouse button to freely move the camera.
The cursor now stays visible at all times, but you can still toggle an aim mode by pressing "X".
You can now zoom all the way in for a first-person view! This should give you a fresh, immersive way to experience Afallon.
I’ve also removed depth of field since it didn’t seem to be well-received. Without it, the game should look a lot clearer and sharper.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/1584901b15c8fd1371ac03df58c7ff7409f76160.png[/img]

[b]New Feature : Adventure Guide[/b]
I’ve added a new UI panel called the Adventure Guide, which will serve as a central hub for important game information.
For now, the Adventure Guide displays two types of renown:

Quest Renown – Earned by completing quests.
Dungeon Renown – Earned by killing bosses in dungeons.
You can view your current renown levels in the Adventure Guide, and there’s a progress bar that fills up as you gain renown. Reaching certain milestones will reward you with gear, crafting materials, or potions.

In the future, I plan to expand the Adventure Guide to include:

A page for owned houses.
A list of discovered settlements (with fast travel options to those settlements).
A detailed dungeon page with information about the dungeons you’ve explored.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/438bdc94d74593c38b504085ffe879e9f7bb4b68.png[/img]

[b]Subtitles[/b]
I’ve added subtitles for all voice lines in the game. Whether you prefer reading along or just want to make sure you don’t miss anything, subtitles should help improve the experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/f24fcd4c3c1941ffe5546b34ce05696974732e24.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/dd9c3ab69de71e5758dea1aef09fa2e551f4e69a.png[/img]
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where two voice lines from the same character could play at the same time.
Fixed an issue where the game could freeze when loading into the world if your FPS was over 140. This happened because NPC spawners were updating per frame and trying to spawn NPCs before the terrain had fully loaded.
A few smaller bugs have been fixed as well to smooth things out.

[b][u]You can check out the updates in the demo![/u][/b]

[b]What’s Next[/b]
I’m sharing some new screenshots of other areas in Afallon with this update, and over the next few months, I’ll be showing off more videos and providing in-depth updates as the early access launch gets closer.

Thanks so much for all the feedback and support! It’s been incredibly helpful, and I couldn’t do this without you. I’m really excited about where things are heading, and I can’t wait to share more soon.

Stay tuned, and see you in Afallon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/b2b2f1499ed8d1ee4d8c87c67faa2da151316519.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/69f99578a1840d58a6a1fcb8da81415ccbcca4f8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/613d83dc46c7ea384c2965a608174417e36dda3d.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update: Afallon Demo Reuploaded with Update 0.8.0
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, adventurers![/b]

I'm excited to announce that the Afallon demo is live again with a brand-new update, version 0.8.0! Alongside a demo store page, this update focuses on improving your gameplay experience with some  enhancements:

[list]
[*] Download Size Halved: The demo now weighs in at 3.5 GB instead of 7 GB!
[*] Faster Startup: Launch times have been reduced from 20 seconds to 12 seconds, so you can dive into the world of Afallon quicker than ever.
[*] Improved Spell Descriptions: All spells now feature clearer, more informative descriptions to help you strategize effectively.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/fe75e6daa56e181e7a0a073a8c52b4ba01437d68.png[/img]   [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/8703be8287543e1cd3dba2375d10476a4501a289.png[/img]
[*] Quest Auto-Tracking: Quests are automatically tracked as soon as you accept them, so you’ll never lose your way.
[*] Rain Performance Boost: Enjoy up to a 42% FPS improvement in rainy weather for smoother gameplay during storms.
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the latest demo, and I’d truly appreciate your feedback! Every comment and suggestion helps make Afallon better.

Thank you for your continued support, and see you in the world of Afallon!

notes.title: Dev update Alpha 0.7.5
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

I'm thrilled to bring you this exciting update on the ongoing development of Afallon! I have been working hard behind the scenes to enhance your experience and add fresh, immersive elements to the game. Here's what's new:
[h1][b]
Complete UI Overhaul[/b][/h1]
I have revamped the user interface from the ground up to ensure it is more intuitive, visually appealing, and easy to navigate. Whether you're managing your inventory, tracking quests, or tweaking game settings, you’ll find the new UI to be a major improvement. You can now see your stats in the character panel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/71cc54058578ac036ff5f38b0c9a718efae8d46f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/aac4cf7bd3c61698204a73ba57e444528a432d8d.png[/img][h1]
[b]Expanded Voice Acting & Cutscenes[/b][/h1]
To make your questing journey more engaging, i added new voice acting and cutscenes! Get ready to dive deeper into the world of Afallon and feel more connected to the characters and stories around you.

[h1][b]Experience from Exploration[/b][/h1]
Exploration is now more rewarding! Material gathering now grants experience points, and picking up items or finding hidden treasures scattered across the world will also earn you valuable XP. I've made exploration feel more fun, so get out there and start discovering!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/7844ebefd04d688fdaf993298f15a2123aaf1ad5.png[/img]

[h1][b]Dynamic Loot Chests[/b][/h1]
Loot chests now scale with your character’s "item power"! As your item power increases, so will the visuals and the quality of rewards you find in chests. The world of Afallon responds dynamically to your progress, offering a more rewarding adventure with each step forward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/d999fc7a59ece4e5c97f0006a4d4aa60c6f366c3.png[/img]

[h1][b]Roguelite Challenge Stones & Dungeons[/b][/h1]
I've added a Roguelite element to Challenge Stones and dungeons. Inside, you’ll find randomized buffs ranging from common to legendary tiers. When you discover a buff, you’ll be presented with three random choices. Select carefully, as these buffs remain active as long as you’re inside the Challenge Stone or dungeon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/d83d9e5e9b414fa6fee668d110114ecc122ff19e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/2c9dfe5a26413dfa5dc0d711cc8bff4b4cb98193.png[/img]

[h1][b]Sacrificial Altar: A New Way to Spend Corrupted Emeralds[/b][/h1]
Corrupted Emeralds, which can be found in chests and dungeons, can now be used at sacrificial altars scattered throughout the game world. The more emeralds you sacrifice, the better the loot you can choose from! Don't worry, if you’re low on emeralds, gold can also be used, but the rewards won't be as powerful as those from corrupted emeralds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/f7235827430d98caf81baa87226c3518f92bac5d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/6bf79f195bfeeb757e144fa697cadfca1eda0145.png[/img]

[h1][b]New Playable Races with Custom Character Creation screens[/b][/h1]
I'm introducing new playable races to make your adventure in Afallon even more personal! With the demo release, you will be able to create characters from three distinct races: Rimeborn, Gravebound, and Woodmere Folk. Each race comes with unique stat bonuses to enhance your gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/6bf66be6438b557886ad2f32d4bd95f38bae090d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/df6935509523b74edb041677d7e12d33c0195fe0.png[/img]

[h1][b]Don’t Worry, I Haven’t Forgotten the Rest of Afallon![/b][/h1]
While I’ve been focusing on updating the demo, I haven’t forgotten about the other parts of Afallon! I'm still hard at work on the entire game world, and I'm happy to share some pictures of other areas I’ve been developing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/1f264fdfed0866d53b0eb2263c0a414fd2ba0cbb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/528ae5937e5ada23628de463b17f29ed3b5bdea5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/2d9d5967ee3c73f61a5182ec7c2245da3bb5dff3.png[/img]

I hope you're as excited as i am for these updates and features! Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping the future of Afallon, and i can't wait for you to experience the re-released demo with all these new elements.

Stay tuned for more updates, and happy adventuring!

notes.title: Alpha 0.6.7 update
notes.content:
[b]Afallon Update 0.6.7[/b]
Hello Adventurers!

I'm thrilled to bring you Update 0.6.7, featuring some highly requested additions and crucial fixes. Here's what's new:

[b]HUD Quest Tracking:[/b]

At last, the feature many of you have been asking for is here! Your active quests will now be displayed on the game HUD.
You’ll see where to go, which enemies to defeat, and what items to collect in your current region.
This should make your questing experience smoother and more immersive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/6b06dbb8a752f2ba0646a8a66b820120c5082c84.png[/img]

[b]New Quests and Items:[/b]

I’ve added several new quests and items to the demo. Dive in and explore these new adventures and treasures!

[b]Major Bug Fix:[/b]

Fixed a significant bug that allowed NPCs to walk through walls and obstacles. Your interactions with NPCs should now feel more natural and realistic.
I hope you enjoy these updates and continue your epic journey in Afallon. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Large demo update for steam next fest
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

I'm excited to announce a major update to the Afallon demo, just in time for Steam Next Fest! As a solo developer, I've been working hard to bring new features and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

[b]New Interior Locations:[/b]

Discover 5 brand new interior locations, including mysterious caves and treacherous quarries. Each location is filled with secrets, challenges, and treasures waiting to be discovered.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/cd0464eb7e3da9bf5cd0067fcd6c43f31cd6256d.png[/img]

[b]New Items:[/b]

Equip yourself with a variety of new weapons, armor, and shields. Whether you prefer melee combat or magic, there’s something new for every adventurer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/c82bab57bd10df752c0d87d95e6041fe8f5aec11.png[/img]

[b]New Enemies:[/b]

Face off against new enemies that will test your skills and strategies. Be prepared for tougher battles and more thrilling encounters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/79d4b06a91078facd968da0d5bf02d4fb9e44d53.png[/img]

[b]Performance Enhancements:
[/b]
Initial startup time has been drastically reduced from 36 seconds to just 15 seconds on SSDs, ensuring you can jump into the action faster than ever.
Improved performance during rain and snow, providing a smoother and more immersive experience regardless of the weather.

[b]Beginner Tutorial:[/b]

A new beginner tutorial has been added to help new players learn the controls and mechanics of Afallon, making it easier to dive into the adventure.

I am incredibly excited to share this demo with you and hope you find it as enjoyable to play as I did to create. Your feedback is invaluable, so please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts and bug reports with me on Discord.

Happy adventuring, and see you in Afallon!

notes.title: Update on Afallon's Development and Demo Progress
notes.content:
Hello Afallon Community,

I'm excited to bring you a brief update on Afallon's development. Despite a small hiccup with unexpected bugs and a memory leak, I've now ironed out these issues, and I'm thrilled to say that the demo's release is on the horizon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/7152e1836b127f1dbf9bf94d630977539ca8d7e2.png[/img]
The extra time also allowed me to implement random world events, like meteor showers that spawn special NPCs and a spine-tingling event where undead rise across the world, offering new challenges and rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/c5e204ad0e742b3f466a448ccf2982e064e2cc46.png[/img]

Stay tuned for the demo release—it's coming your way very soon. Your adventure is just beginning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800021/42950a691c30c146f7c23cd69217d138f4ec5dd1.png[/img]
